threats.title: Internet exposed module handling sensitive workflow data
threats.description: Detect modules reachable from the internet that participate in workflows handling confidential, secret, or regulated objects.

framework_mappings.mapping_rationale: Internet-exposed services handling sensitive data are prime targets for public-facing exploitation.
Sensitive internet-facing workflows often include credential attack surfaces that can enable valid account abuse.

threats.rationale: Internet-exposed module intersects with sensitive workflow context.

threats.title: Low-trust to high-value object dependency path
threats.description: Identify dependency chains beginning in low-trust domains and ending at confidential, secret, or regulated objects through datastores.

framework_mappings.mapping_rationale: Dependency chains from low-trust zones indicate likely remote-service lateral movement paths to high-value assets.
Path access to critical objects implies elevated impact potential on high-value data.

threats.rationale: Low-trust dependency path reaches high-value object.

threats.title: High-privilege module externally reachable
threats.description: Flag modules with service/admin privilege that are internet-exposed or reachable through workflows involving external actors.

framework_mappings.mapping_rationale: Externally reachable privileged modules increase likelihood of exploit-driven privilege escalation.
High-privilege reachable services are at risk of persistence through account abuse.

threats.title: AI-relevant module dependency and model service exposure
threats.description: Detect modules that depend on AI-relevant services and can influence model inputs, feature stores, or inference surfaces.

framework_mappings.mapping_rationale: AI-relevant module and feature pipeline dependencies create poisoning opportunities.
Inference-facing AI dependencies can be abused via evasion-style inputs.
ML pipeline dependencies expose data manipulation opportunities across model inputs.

threats.rationale: Module dependency exposes AI-relevant service surface.

threats.title: Regulated object concentration in critical workflows
threats.description: Highlight workflows in high or critical systems that involve multiple regulated objects and privileged modules.

framework_mappings.mapping_rationale: Regulated objects concentrated in critical workflows are high-value collection targets.
Critical workflows carrying regulated data increase exfiltration automation risk.

threats.rationale: Critical workflow aggregates regulated data and privileged modules.

threats.title: Trust boundary crossing with privileged dependency
threats.description: Detect dependencies that traverse defined trust boundaries and terminate in privileged backend or datastore components.

framework_mappings.mapping_rationale: Boundary crossing dependencies can support staged tool transfer into trusted zones.
Cross-boundary privileged dependencies can be abused through token/key-based movement.

threats.rationale: Dependency can cross trust boundary into privileged/sensitive zone.
